Ava (CEO): Thanks for a packed all-hands — opening a live thread for quick follow-ups about mission, positioning, and competitor posture. Keep items short and tag owners.

Meera (Product): Quick: can marketing quote 'production-first' verbatim externally or do we need a safety line?

Rafael (CTO): You can use it but pair with concrete proof points (SLA tiers, rollback behavior). We don't want fuzzy claims alone.

Sam (Sales): Sales needs a 2-line battlecard contrasting Redwood vs general cloud endpoints. Prefer explicit callouts (cost predictability, rollout controls).

Ava (CEO): Approved. Meera + Sam, collaborate on a 1-pager. Keep one sentence for execs, one for engineers. Drop by EOD tomorrow.

Eli (Eng): For Dedicated pilots: what runtime features are non-negotiable to include? customers want canary routing + KV cache.
